title: Progression guide
summary: The whole path from day one to the Ender Wyrm, with rough levels and gear for each stage.

s.x: SkyRPG has a long ladder and no single route up it. This page lays out the path in eight stages, matched to the eight chapters of the Skyhaven Chronicle. For each stage it gives the skill levels to aim for, the gear that unlocks, and the places to go. The numbers are the levels the game itself uses: skill levels needed to craft or buy gear, the levels of dungeons and mobs, and the checks the questline makes.
Levels here are rough guides. You do not need to be exactly there. Read the gear tables as "you can start using this at about this level".
Every skill follows the same loop:
gather, refine, craft, wear better gear, gather deeper.
Gathering gives skill XP, and every skill level gives stats and a talent point.
Materials are refined and crafted into gear at the
. Many recipes need the previous tier of the same item, and the new one keeps its name and enchantments.
Recipes unlock by skill level, and many mid-tier ones also need a collection tier. See
Better tools reach better materials. Pickaxes and axes have tiers (I to VII), and a hard ore will not break with a weaker tool.
Tougher gear lets you survive further from spawn, where mobs have higher levels. That is where the rare drops are.
